name: FolderToLLM Context Packager
subtitle: Build filtered project context snapshots
description: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that builds bounded, reviewable text snapshots from accessible project folders. Supports include/exclude path and extension filters, file-size limits, best-effort .gitignore rules, common generated/binary exclusions, and directory-tree output. It is read-only and does not grant filesystem permissions; review generated context before sharing because automated exclusions cannot guarantee that all secrets are removed.
capabilities: Filter project files by folders and extensions
Review included and skipped files before sharing
starterPrompts: Create a context snapshot of ./src, include only .ts and .md files, and keep it under 80000 characters.
Prepare project context for debugging and report excluded files and safety warnings.
Show the FolderToLLM defaults and explain the available filters.
